description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans silo shutdown scenarios, including request forwarding, timer handling, and stuck activation tests. It sets up a test cluster with multiple silos, configures silo options, and defines test methods to verify graceful shutdown behavior.

classes.name: ShutdownSiloTests
classes.description: Contains tests for verifying the behavior of Orleans silos during graceful shutdown, including handling of pending requests, timers, and stuck activations.

classes.name: SiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures silo options such as deactivation timeout, clustering, and placement strategy for testing.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Checks preconditions before running tests, such as verifying Azure storage availability.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with initial silo count and custom configurator.

methods.name: ShutdownSiloTests
methods.description: Constructor that ensures preconditions are met before tests run.

methods.name: SiloGracefulShutdown_ForwardPendingRequest
methods.description: Tests that pending requests are forwarded correctly during silo shutdown.

methods.name: SiloGracefulShutdown_PendingRequestTimers
methods.description: Verifies that timers pending during shutdown complete properly.

methods.name: SiloGracefulShutdown_StuckTimers
methods.description: Checks that stuck timers cause the shutdown to take longer than the deactivation timeout.

methods.name: SiloGracefulShutdown_StuckActivation
methods.description: Ensures that a stuck activation is handled within a specified timeout during shutdown.

methods.name: GetLongRunningTaskGrainOnSecondary
methods.description: Retrieves a long-running task grain on a secondary silo, ensuring correct placement.

methods.name: GetTimerRequestGrainOnSecondary
methods.description: Retrieves a timer request grain on a secondary silo, ensuring correct placement.
